files.README.md:
Brackenridge House door system audit, 8 September.

Cards starting with T are the housekeeping trainer set used on floor 4.
Rooms 401-412 are closed for renovation, so T-card opens are training
drills for staff. Guest activity is K-cards only.

turns.prompt: Front desk at Brackenridge House — the door system dumped its card audit for 8 September and the duty manager wants a plain summary: how many genuine guest unlocks there were, which room saw the most traffic, and whether the log shows anything that needs explaining.
